Internal Resources Division: This is the government division within the Ministry of Finance responsible for issuing customs and value added tax notifications.
Ministry of Finance: The government ministry overseeing the Internal Resources Division which handles customs and tax regulatory matters.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19 of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to amend customs notifications in the public interest.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act serves as a foundational legal basis alongside the Customs Act 1969 for this amendment.
National Board of Revenue: The Government is mandated to consult with this board when exercising its powers to amend customs and tax-related notifications.
S.R.O. 202-AIN/95/1639/CUS: This existing notification is amended to expand the scope of tax and duty exemptions to include services in addition to previously covered goods.
The amendments involve replacing terminology across the preamble, headings, and specific conditions to ensure consistency in the application of exemptions for imported services and machinery.
